title: Markov — a Monte-Carlo Sampling Studio
description: Watch fifteen from-scratch samplers — Metropolis, adaptive, MALA, HMC, NUTS, Gibbs, slice, parallel tempering, the affine-invariant ensemble (emcee), the non-reversible Bouncy Particle sampler, Barker, curvature-aware Riemannian MALA (which beats Neal's funnel), Hit-and-Run, plus two that break the single-chain mold: Stein Variational Gradient Descent, a deterministic swarm that repels itself to TILE the density, and adaptive tempered Sequential Monte Carlo, a weighted population that anneals off a Gaussian and READS OFF log Z — the normalising constant every Markov chain is blind to (for the logistic target, the Bayesian model evidence itself), scored live against the exact value. Explore nine tricky targets in real time; race two head-to-head on the same seed with a live ESS/efficiency/accuracy compare bar; auto-tune HMC/NUTS with Nesterov dual averaging; share any experiment by link. Live diagnostics: ESS, split-R̂, autocorrelation, cost-aware efficiency, Monte-Carlo standard error, total-variation distance with a signed shape-error heatmap, and the model-evidence estimate. Long-exposure sample cloud and CSV export.
